It depends on the money you have to spend vs. the realism or detail of the models. For instance, Bachmann, while inexpensive, does not have great detail and has more of a toy feel. Depending on how much money and time you have or want to spend, is how you need to approach this awesome hobby.

I would suggest you do some investigating on the internet, places like Model Railroader, and the like, most train hobby stores are also on line and can be a great source of information.
